description_for_human: Create projects, get governance briefs, and check plan usage for the GIABO Digital PMO Swarm.

functions.name: createProject
functions.description: Create a new PMO project. Call immediately without asking for tenant or project UUIDs. Accepts a project name (name or projectName), optional SharePoint site (sharepoint_site_id / sharepointUrl), optional sponsor (sponsorName), and optional digital employee name/email.

functions.name: getProjectBrief
functions.description: Get a structured markdown governance brief -- open risks, open actions, and the recent swarm agent audit log -- for a project.

functions.name: getUsageTelemetry
functions.description: Get a tenant's plan tier, swarm health, active project count, and metered token/overage usage.
